info.title: Cultuurconnect Catalogus Webservices
info.summary: Search, describe and locate holdings across the Flemish public library catalogues.
info.description:
OpenAPI description of the Cultuurconnect *Catalogus webservices v1* (AquaBrowser), reconstructed from the public documentation and verified against the live staging endpoint `https://cataloguswebservices.bibliotheek.be/staging/zbb`.

## Profiles

There is a single host for every library profile; the profile is the first path segment, e.g. `/zbb/search/` (the union catalogue bibliotheek.be), `/wetteren/search/`, `/gent/search/`. Staging is reached by inserting `/staging` **before** the profile: `/staging/zbb/search/`. Both are modelled as server variables (`env`, `profile`).

## Authorisation

Every request carries `?authorization=<key>`. Keys are requested via helpdesk@cultuurconnect.be and are scoped to specific profiles — a key that works on one profile returns `401` on another.

Two tiers exist. The **rich API** includes data Cultuurconnect licenses from third parties (cover images, summaries, reviews) and may only be used by non-commercial applications that promote the reach of Flemish or Brussels public libraries. The **free API** omits that data; fields affected are marked in their descriptions.

## Response format

The documented format is XML, rooted at `<aquabrowser>` (the published documentation calls this element `root`; the live service does not). `/search/`, `/details/` and `/availability/` additionally accept `output=json`, which is undocumented — see the `output` parameter for its caveats.

## Rate and volume

The API is served from the live AquaBrowser instances, so callers are asked to limit request volume and to cache result sets. `pagesize` above the default of 20 requires a key with extra rights.

## Reading the XML schemas

XML attributes are marked with `xml: { attribute: true }`. Many elements carry both attributes and text content; because the OpenAPI XML Object has no way to express character data, that text is modelled as a property named `value` marked `x-xml-text: true`. Such a property is the element's own text, not a child element.

Path templates keep their trailing slash — it is significant. `/search` without it returns `404`.

## Not modelled here

`/locations` appears in the published documentation, but its own example points at a different legacy host (`hs.aquabrowser.be/locations/list/`) and the path returns `404` on the current service. It is deliberately omitted rather than described speculatively.

license.name: Usage governed by the API key agreement with Cultuurconnect

env.description: Empty for production, `/staging` for the staging deployment. Note that `/holdings` and the profile-less variants of `/index/all` and `/availability?global=true` are not deployed on staging (502).

profile.description: Library profile. `zbb` is the union catalogue behind bibliotheek.be; other values are library or regional profiles such as `wetteren`, `gent`, `aalst`, `waregem`, `oostvlaanderen`, `luisterpunt`.

tags.name: records

get.description:
Runs a query against the profile's catalogue and returns a paged result list.

`q` accepts free text or one or more index prefixes (`author:`, `title:`, `bibno:`, `Format:`, `relation_article:`, …) as described in the zoektaal documentation. Results are grouped per work by default (FRABL key); pass `dedup=false` to see every edition separately.

Facets are only returned when `refine=true`, and `facet=` filtering only takes effect together with `refine=true`.

A `<search-availability-ids>` block in the response carries a ready-made `<post>` body for `POST /search-availability/`, so availability for a whole result page can be fetched in one follow-up call.

When fewer than three results are found the response carries a `feedbacks/noresults/parent-sites` block pointing at the parent catalogue where the query can be repeated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query. Free text, or one or more index prefixes. Use `q=special:list` when retrieving explicit records via the `id` parameter.

explicitList.summary: Use together with one or more `id` parameters

parameters.name: refine
parameters.description: Return the `<facets>` block so the result set can be refined. Required for `facet=` to have any effect.

parameters.name: facet
parameters.description: Restrict the result set to a facet value, e.g. `Format(Book)`. Only honoured together with `refine=true`. Repeat the parameter to combine facets.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Restrict results to one library location, given as its full path, e.g. `West-Vlaanderen/Kortrijk/Aalbeke`. Within a profile several branches are taken together as one library.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page of results to return.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. The default of 20 is also the ceiling for an ordinary key — larger pages require a key with specific rights, and requesting one without those rights makes the service stall rather than return an error.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. An unrecognised value produces a `500` from the sorter rather than a validation error.

parameters.name: dedup
parameters.description: Group editions of the same work on their FRABL key. Set to `false` to list every edition separately.

parameters.name: hith
parameters.description: Hit highlighting. When true, matched terms are wrapped in `<exact>` elements.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Retrieve one or more specific records by id. Must be combined with `q=special:list`. Results come back in id order unless `sort` is given.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Restrict to a named subset configured for the profile, e.g. `cover` (only records with a cover image). Subsets are per-profile; an unknown name yields a `500` (`No such subset '…'`).

parameters.name: coversize
parameters.description: Size of the cover image URLs in the response. Rich API only.

parameters.name: librarian
parameters.description: Add the `<librarian-info>` block with MARC and matching source data for cataloguers.

200.description: Result list. `meta/count` is 0 when nothing matched — that is not an error.

application/xml.example:
<aquabrowser version="1" before-rendering-time="925" total-time="206" detail-level="Default">
  <meta>
    <count>83</count>
    <page>1</page>
    <rctx>AR3EQQ6CMBAF0F8qIYQFa2NceALUeBT2pJRCh5QWymAiJ$U4GhfvCcgCGR6f@h1Gtn667$0StH51dtzVuEiBfFLkIZGzWfmfSC@URKPX2cRZDUY$r7qxxJYG63646JVbTQIc5VEmtTjVAjhvnoLXipULA4BbFUPgytGyUVftbZtt0SH1TnwB</rctx>
  </meta>
  <feedbacks>
    <search-availability-ids>
      <ids>
        <id extid="|library/marc/vlacc|6967964" cnt="1">790988</id>
      </ids>
      <post>%7clibrary%2fmarc%2fvlacc%7c6967964=790988</post>
    </search-availability-ids>
  </feedbacks>
  <results>
    <result>
      <id nativeid="6967964" ds="library/m/vlacc" translation="Id">|library/marc/vlacc|6967964</id>
      <frabl translation="Frabl">61B74575E8F1AC00</frabl>
      <detail-page>http://zbb.staging.aquabrowser.be/detail/Khaled-Hosseini/...</detail-page>
      <titles>
        <title translation="Titel" search-method="title" search-term="Duizend schitterende zonnen">Duizend schitterende zonnen</title>
      </titles>
      <authors>
        <main-author firstname="Khaled" lastname="Hosseini" birthyear="1965-" creatortype="person" localized-type="Auteur" main="true" wikidata="Q93341" translation="Auteur">Khaled Hosseini</main-author>
      </authors>
      <formats>
        <format raw="book" translation="Materiaal" search-method="Format" search-term="Book">Boek</format>
      </formats>
      <languages>
        <language raw="dut" translation="Taal">Nederlands</language>
        <original-language raw="eng" translation="Oorspronkelijke taal">Engels</original-language>
      </languages>
      <undup-info key="61B74575E8F1AC00" cnt="83" frabl-key1="a thousand splendid suns" frabl-key2="hosseini,khaled" frabl-global-count="83">

          <item extid="|library/marc/vlacc|6967964" frabl="61B74575E8F1AC00" language="Nederlands" year="2008" globalholdingscount="212"/>
        </format>
      </undup-info>

  <sort>

    <option id="year" translation="Jaar"/>
  </sort>
</aquabrowser>

get.description:
Returns the complete description of a single record. Supply either `id` (a specific bibliographic record) or `frabl` (a work key — the most relevant edition is returned).

The body contains every element `/search/` returns per result, plus `<branches>`, `<ratings>` (kijkwijzer, PEGI) and `<reviews>`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Record id, as found in the `<id>` element of a search result. Mutually exclusive with `frabl`; one of the two is required.

parameters.name: frabl
parameters.description: FRABL key grouping all editions of a work. The most relevant edition is returned. Mutually exclusive with `id`; one of the two is required.

parameters.name: librarian
parameters.description: Add the `<librarian-info>` block with MARC and matching source data for cataloguers.

200.description: The record. Its elements are direct children of the root — there is no `<record>` wrapper.

application/xml.example:
<aquabrowser version="1" before-rendering-time="111" total-time="53" detail-level="Default">
  <meta>
    <rctx>AWNkYOZmYGcwzMgrTzfIKslJL0nJNawoNcnLy...</rctx>
  </meta>
  <id nativeid="10438540" ds="library/m/vlacc" translation="Id">|library/marc/vlacc|10438540</id>
  <frabl translation="Frabl">39681F00FAF1AC00</frabl>
  <detail-page>http://zbb.staging.aquabrowser.be/detail/Bella-Mackie/...</detail-page>
  <copyright>Bibliografische gegevens: Cultuurconnect</copyright>
  <titles>
    <title translation="Titel" search-method="title">Hoe vermoord ik mijn familie?</title>
    <origin-title translation="Oorspronkelijke titel">How to kill your family</origin-title>
  </titles>
  <authors>
    <main-author firstname="Bella" lastname="Mackie" birthyear="1957-" creatortype="person" localized-type="Auteur" main="true" translation="Auteur">Bella Mackie</main-author>
  </authors>
  <formats>
    <format raw="book" translation="Materiaal">Boek</format>
  </formats>
  <identifiers>
    <isbn-id note="paperback" translation="ISBN">9789023477426</isbn-id>
    <normalized-isbn-id translation="ISBN">9789023477426</normalized-isbn-id>
  </identifiers>
  <publication>
    <publishers>
      <publisher place="Amsterdam" year="2025" translation="Uitgave">De Bezige Bij</publisher>
    </publishers>
  </publication>
  <description>
    <pages translation="Aantal pagina's">397</pages>
    <physical-description translation="Kenmerken">397 p.</physical-description>
  </description>
  <ratings/>
  <services>
    <service name="wikipedia" type="jscallback" url="https://nl.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?..."/>
  </services>
</aquabrowser>

get.summary: Availability of one title across locations
get.description:
Returns holdings and per-item availability for a record and for all editions sharing its language and material type.

Querying by `frabl` is recommended over `id`, because it covers every edition of the work. `branch` moves the requested location to the top of the `<locations>` tree.

`global=true` widens the answer to every connected library; the profile segment may then be omitted from the path. Global access is granted per key on request, and the profile-less form is not deployed on staging.

parameters.name: frabl
parameters.description: FRABL key of the work. Preferred over `id`. One of `frabl` or `id` is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Record id. One of `frabl` or `id` is required.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Put this location's holdings at the top of the `<locations>` tree.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Return availability across every connected library instead of just this profile. Requires a key entitled to global availability; the profile segment may be dropped from the path when set.

application/xml.example:
<aquabrowser version="1" before-rendering-time="512" total-time="120">
  <meta>
    <frabl>61B74575E8F1ACA0</frabl>
    <detail-page>http://zbb.staging.aquabrowser.be/detail/...</detail-page>
    <records>
      <record nativeid="10576344" ds="library/m/vlacc" extid="|library/marc/vlacc|10576344" is-lead="true">
        <title>Hoe vermoord ik mijn familie?</title>
        <author>Bella Mackie</author>
        <publisher>De Bezige Bij</publisher>
        <publisher-year>2025</publisher-year>
      </record>
    </records>
  </meta>
  <locations>
    <location name="Antwerpen" id="/root/bibnet/Antwerpen/Antwerpen" available="true" url="http://antwerpen.staging.aquabrowser.be/">
      <location name="Bibliotheek Permeke (Antwerpen)" id="/root/bibnet/Antwerpen/Antwerpen/Antwerpen-Permeke" available="false">
        <holding id="/root/bibnet/Antwerpen/Antwerpen/Antwerpen-Permeke" name="Bibliotheek Permeke" latitude="51.2211" longitude="4.4210" wise-id="ANT">
          <address>
            <street>De Coninckplein</street>
            <number>25</number>
            <postcode>2060</postcode>
            <city>Antwerpen</city>
          </address>
          <opening-hours>
            <monday date="2026-08-10">
              <timespan open="10:00" close="18:00"/>
            </monday>
          </opening-hours>
        </holding>
        <items>
          <item available="false" extid="|library/marc/vlacc|10576344" status="loanedout" count="1">
            <subloc>Romans</subloc>
            <shelfmark>MACK</shelfmark>
            <status>Uitgeleend</status>
            <returndate>30-08-2026</returndate>
            <itemid>33421539</itemid>
            <wiseid>5065406</wiseid>
          </item>
        </items>
      </location>
    </location>
  </locations>
</aquabrowser>

post.summary: Availability for a page of search results
post.description:
Bulk availability for a set of titles, intended for annotating a whole page of search results in one call.

The request body is **not** a normal form: it is the raw form-urlencoded text taken verbatim from the `<search-availability-ids><post>` node of the corresponding `/search/` response. Each line pairs a percent-encoded external id with the Wise title ids that belong to it.

The response reports `available` as soon as one present copy is found — it does not count the remaining copies, so no total is returned.

This operation needs a profile that maps to a Wise location. Union-catalogue profiles such as `zbb` return `404 NotFound` (`holding does not have a wise locationcode`).

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Answer from this branch's point of view; the first `<status>` of every item is then the branch status. Same syntax as `branch` on `/search/`.

requestBody.description: Newline-separated `<url-encoded-extid>=<wise-title-id>[,<wise-title-id>…]` lines, copied from the `<post>` node of a `/search/` response.

schema.description: Raw body. Not a key/value form — the whole payload is the id mapping.

get.description:
Returns the refinement facets. Without parameters it lists every configured facet for the profile; with `rctx` it returns the facets for a user's current search context. It doubles as a way to enumerate the terms of an index, e.g. all awards.

By default at most five terms per facet are returned; raise that with `count`.

This operation is XML only — `output=json` returns `Content-Type: application/json` with an XSLT error in the body.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of terms per facet.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Limit the answer to one or more named facets. Repeat the parameter for several.

get.summary: List the configured indexes and facets
get.description:
Lists every index and facet configured for the profile.

A profile-less variant (`https://cataloguswebservices.bibliotheek.be/index/all/`) lists the global configuration, but it is only deployed in production — on staging it returns `502`.

XML only.

get.summary: Browse the terms of one index
get.description:
Returns the entries of a single index, paged. At most 100 entries are available per index and at most 20 per page.

XML only. An unknown index type returns `404` with the list of allowed indexes in the reason — that list is the source of the enum below and differs from the published documentation, which names `subjects` instead of `subject` and omits `review`.

parameters.name: indexType
parameters.description: Index to browse.

parameters.name: curpage
parameters.description: 1-based page of index entries.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: Entries per page. The service enforces a maximum of 20 and reports it as `pagesize/@enforcedmaximum`.

get.summary: Resolve an external identifier to catalogue ids
get.description:
Matches identifiers onto the records they occur in. Use it to turn a book database with its own identifiers into catalogue ids, and then fetch the descriptions with `/details/`.

Bibliographic types: `ean`, `isbn`, `issn`, `frabl`. Source-system types: `ppn` (not used in Flanders), `admin_doc_number` (PBS Vlaams-Brabant only), `bibno` (the record that came out of matching as master), `doc_number` (local record number without needing to know the master), `nativeid` (AquaBrowser record number without prefix), `extid` (local record number with prefix).

XML only.

parameters.name: idType
parameters.description: Kind of identifier being resolved.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier to resolve. Repeat the parameter to resolve several of the same type in one call.

parameters.name: dedup
parameters.description: Group editions of the same work on their FRABL key.

servers.description: Holdings sit outside the profile prefix. Only deployed in production — `/staging/holdings/…` returns 502.

env.description: Empty for production. `/staging` is accepted by the URL scheme but not deployed for this endpoint.

get.summary: List library branches with addresses and opening hours
get.description:
Lists the branches of a profile, enriched with opening hours, exceptional closing days, address details and website.

`holdingPath` is the holding tree path and contains slashes, e.g. `Oost-Vlaanderen/Wetteren` or `root/bibnet/Brussel`. OpenAPI has no first-class variable-depth path parameter, so the value is documented here as a slash-separated string that must **not** be percent-encoded. Omitting it entirely (`/holdings/`) returns every connected library.

XML only.

parameters.name: holdingPath
parameters.description: Slash-separated holding path. Slashes are path separators, not data — do not percent-encode them. Leave empty to list all connected libraries.

parameters.name: includeparent
parameters.description: Also return the parent holding. Required in practice for libraries that have no sub-holdings, since otherwise nothing is returned.

parameters.name: closeinfodays
parameters.description: How many days ahead exceptional closing days are reported.

parameters.name: show-region-profiles
parameters.description: Include regional cooperation profiles (Route 42, Dijk92, Bibkwintet, …). Because a region combines sub-locations of several libraries, holdings then appear more than once.

200.description: Holdings with opening hours and addresses.

authorization.name: authorization
authorization.description: API key issued by Cultuurconnect (helpdesk@cultuurconnect.be). Keys are scoped to specific profiles and to either the rich or the free API. A missing key yields `401 UnAuthorized / Missing authorization`; a key that is not configured for the profile yields `401 UnAuthorized / The provided authorization key is not configured.`

lang.name: lang
lang.description: Output language. Needed to have coded values rendered as words — material codes, branch codes, language codes — and to populate `@translation` attributes. An unsupported value returns `409 FailedValidation`.

output.name: output
output.description: Response format. **`json` is undocumented** and only implemented on `/search/`, `/details/` and `/availability/` (error bodies included). Caveats: the body starts with a UTF-8 BOM (`EF BB BF`) — WHATWG `fetch().text()` strips it silently, but decoders working on the raw bytes must strip it themselves or parsing fails; the JSON keys do not mirror the XML element names (`detailLink`, `authorsDetailed`, `alsoAvailableAsCount`, …); and the `facets` block is silently omitted even when `refine=true`. On `/refine/`, `/index/` and `/resolver/` the service answers `Content-Type: application/json` with an XSLT error in the body.

detaillevel.name: detaillevel
detaillevel.description: How much of each record to return. `minimum` — detail link, title, author, cover image and frabl/id only. `basic` — everything needed to render a result list. `default` — the full standard description. `extended` — adds MARC21. `librarian` — like `extended` plus enrichment info. An unrecognised value returns `409 FailedValidation`.

rctx.name: rctx
rctx.description: Opaque search-context token echoed in `meta/rctx`. Carries the user's search history (query, applied refinements) and is not session-bound, so it can be passed between calls and between endpoints — notably to keep result-list navigation intact on `/details/` and to scope `/refine/`.

Unauthorized.description: No key supplied, or the key is not configured for this profile.

application/xml.example: UnAuthorizedThe provided authorization key is not configured.

FailedValidation.description: A required parameter is missing or a parameter value is invalid.

NotFound.description: The requested index, identifier type, record or holding does not exist.

application/xml.example: NotFoundIndex bogus is not one of the allowed indexes: author, awards, subject, language, format, targetaudience, readinglevel, type, genre, review.

ServerError.description: Internal failure. Notably raised for an unknown `sort` value or an unknown `s` subset, which are not treated as validation errors.

application/xml.example: ServerErrorHardSorter - definitions for sort 'bogus' not found. '' = def(ault)

ErrorResponse.description: Application-level error. Returned alongside the HTTP status.

ErrorJsonResponse.description: Error body returned when `output=json`. Carries a UTF-8 BOM.

SearchResponse.description: Result list. Note the root element is `<aquabrowser>`; the published documentation calls it `root`.

results.description: The matching records. `<result>` itself carries no attributes — the `@search-*` attributes live on the leaf elements inside it.

facets.description: Only present when `refine=true`. Same two-level shape as `/refine/`: each `<facet>` holds its terms as `<value>` children.

sort.description: Available sort options with the active one flagged.

count.description: Number of results. `0` means nothing matched — see `feedbacks/noresults`.

rctx.description: Search-context token to pass to subsequent calls.

Feedbacks.description: Query feedback: enrichment services, author pages, query expansion and no-result fallbacks.

service.description: Callback services relevant to the query as a whole, e.g. a Wikipedia lookup.

authorpage.description: Present when the query resolves to an author.

noresults.description: Shown with fewer than three results, so the user can be sent to the parent catalogue.

queryexpansion.description: Terms the query was expanded with, e.g. Birma → Myanmar.

userfeedback.description: HTML feedback configured per library for particular queries.

FeedbackService.description: External service to call for enrichment.

ParentSite.description: Catalogue one level up, where the query can be repeated.

profile.description: Profile name of the parent site.

translation.description: Display label for the parent site.

term.description: Term the query was expanded with.

index.description: Index the expansion was taken from.

ids.description: External catalogue id mapped to the Wise title ids it covers. One Wise title id exists per edition.

frabl-ids.description: The same mapping keyed per FRABL, so availability can be requested for a whole work.

post.description: The id mapping already form-urlencoded — send this verbatim as the `POST /search-availability/` body.

frabl-post.description: The same body built from `frabl-ids`, so availability is requested per work rather than per edition. Not in the published documentation.

SearchAvailabilityIdEntry.description: Comma-separated Wise title ids, keyed by external id.

cnt.description: Number of Wise title ids in this entry.

digital.description: The edition is a digital item. Only on `ids` entries.

TranslatedText.description: Leaf element whose text is the displayable value. `@translation` holds the label for the field in the language given by `lang`.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.

SearchLinkText.description: Leaf element that is also a search link: the `@search-*` attributes describe the query that would retrieve everything sharing this value.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.

search-type.description: How the term should be matched.

RawSearchLinkText.description: Search link that also exposes the underlying code. `@raw` is the uncoded value (material code, language code, …) of which the element text is the rendered form.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.

value.description: Rendered value in the requested language.

Record.description:
One bibliographic record.

The same set of elements is returned inside `results/result`, directly under the root on `/details/`, and recursively as `children`/`parents`. Which blocks appear depends on `detaillevel`, on `librarian`, on the rich-vs-free tier, and on what the record itself carries — treat every property as optional.

Note that the container elements (`titles`, `authors`, `formats`, …) carry **no** attributes; `@translation` and the `@search-*` search-link attributes sit on the leaf elements inside them.

detail-page.description: URL of the record's detail page in AquaBrowser. For a website description this may be the URL of the site itself.

coverimages.description: Cover images. Not available in the free API.

formats.description: Material types. `@raw` carries the material code, the text its rendering in the requested language.

types.description: Publication types: Fictie, Non-Fictie, Muziek, Film.

summaries.description: Summaries. Not available in the free API.

children.description: Child records, e.g. the parts of an omnibus. Each child is a full record description.

parents.description: Parent records, e.g. the omnibus this record is part of. Each parent is a full record description.

RecordId.description: Record id. The text content is the full id used by `/details/` and `/availability/`; the attributes break it into its parts.

nativeid.description: Record number within AquaBrowser, without prefix.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.

CoverImage.description: Cover image. Not available in the free API.

url.description: Image URL. Defaults to the small size; request `coversize=large` for a bigger one.

Titles.description: Titles. Only `title` is a search link; the rest carry a label only.

Author.description: Contributor. With `lang=nl` the text content is rendered as `firstname lastname`.

localized-type.description: Author function rendered in the requested language.

preposition.description: Name preposition split off the surname, e.g. `van` in `Ludwig van Beethoven`.

associated.description: Contributor is associated with rather than responsible for the work. Secondary authors only.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.

isbn-id.description: ISBN as catalogued. `@note` carries a free annotation such as `paperback`.

normalized-isbn-id.description: ISBN reduced to digits, suitable for matching. Not in the published documentation.

translation.description: Field label in the requested language.
Field label in the requested language.

Languages.description: Languages of the publication. The code `und` (undetermined) is suppressed. `@raw` holds the ISO code, the text its rendering.

original-language.description: Language the work was translated from.

Classification.description: Classification codes with shelving suggestions. Singular `<classification>` — the published documentation calls it `classifications`.

translation.description: Block label in the requested language.

platforms.description: Game platforms. Wrapper is `platforms`, not `platform` as the documentation says.

CodedTerm.description: Term carrying its own classification code.

local-subject.description: Subject term local to the library.

TypedTerm.description: Subject heading. `@type` carries the thesaurus type where the source record distinguishes one.

EResource.description: Associated online resource. Wrapper and element are `eresources`/`eresource`; the documentation writes them hyphenated.

Summary.description: Summary. Not available in the free API.

query.description: Ready-made query retrieving the whole series.

Articles.description: Sub-articles, as carried by a magazine record.

Magazines.description: For an article, the magazine it appeared in.

translation.description: Block label in the requested language.

Magazine.description: The magazine an article was published in. Carries a reduced record description.

UndupInfo.description: Grouping information for all editions of a work.

key.description: Grouping key: hex bit-encoded key1, key2, material and language.

cnt.description: Number of grouped editions in this catalogue.

sort.description: Sort key used to order the grouped editions.

frabl-key1.description: Title component of the FRABL key.

frabl-key2.description: Author component of the FRABL key.

undup-all-search.description: Ready-made query retrieving every edition in the group.

icon.description: Icon path for the material type.

undup-all-search.description: Query retrieving every edition of this material type.

globalholdingscount.description: Number of holdings for this edition.

EnrichInfo.description: How this record was matched against other bibliographic ids.

translation.description: Block label in the requested language.

extid.description: Bibliographic id of the matched edition.

dsname.description: Data source the match came from.

criterion.description: Criterion the record was matched on.

LibrarianInfo.description: Source data for librarians and cataloguers. Only present with `librarian=true`.

meta.description: Record metadata as held in AquaBrowser.

cdr-id.description: Centrale Discotheek Rotterdam id, usable with the CDR mini-player.

eresources.description: Links to YouTube or Spotify, where available.

RecordCustom.description: Profile-specific extras. Which children appear depends on the profile and on the record.

images.description: Image references attached to the record.

luisterpunt.description: Luisterpunt, the library for people with a visual impairment. Present on records Luisterpunt also holds, not only within the `luisterpunt` profile.

playingtime.description: Length of the Luisterpunt recording, `mm:ss`. Spelled without a hyphen here, unlike `description/playing-time`.

translation.description: Link label in the requested language.

Facet.description: Refinement facet with its terms. On `/search/` it is only returned with `refine=true`; `/refine/` returns the same shape. The facet itself carries no count — counts sit on the individual `<value>` terms.

translation.description: Facet label in the requested language.

FacetValue.description: One term of a facet. Combine facet id and term id to build the `facet=` parameter, e.g. `Format(Book)`.

count.description: How many results carry this term.

translation.description: Term label in the requested language, e.g. `book` → `boek`.

active.description: True on the sort currently applied.

translation.description: Sort label in the requested language.

DetailsResponse.description:
Full description of one record.

**There is no `<record>` wrapper**: the record's own elements — `id`, `titles`, `authors`, `formats` and the rest of `Record` — are direct children of `<aquabrowser>`, alongside `meta`, `ratings`, `services` and (where the profile and tier provide them) `branches` and `reviews`.

services.description: Enrichment services to call for this record, e.g. a Wikipedia lookup. Details-only.

branches.description: Library locations holding this record. Present on single-library profiles; the `zbb` union catalogue answers with `locations` from `/availability/` instead.

reviews.description: Reviews. Not available in the free API.

Ratings.description: Content ratings for multimedia and games. Empty when the record carries none.

kijkwijzer-codes.description: Dutch/Flemish Kijkwijzer content ratings. The child element is `kijkwijzer`.

pegi-codes.description: PEGI game ratings; several may apply to one title.

RatingIcon.description: One rating with its icon. The attribute is `icon-src`, singular — the documentation writes `icons-src`.

Review.description: Review. Not available in the free API.

AvailabilityResponse.description: Where a title is held and whether copies are on the shelf.

records.description: The records whose availability was aggregated.

locations.description: Library-level locations, each containing branch-level locations.

AvailabilityRecord.description: Source record behind an availability answer.

extid.description: Original id from the library system.

is-lead.description: This record is the one the request resolved to.

coverimage.description: Cover image on the cover server. Not available in the free API.

LocationLevel.description: A location. The outer level is a library; nested `location` elements are its branches.

available.description: At least one copy is on the shelf here.

profile-branch.description: This profile is the one selected in the URL. Library level only.

branch-selected.description: This branch is the one selected in the URL. Branch level only.

Holding.description: Details of a library location. The same element is returned by `/holdings/` and inside `/availability/`.

category.description: Kind of location, e.g. main library or branch.

longitude.description: Longitude. The published documentation misspells this as `longtitude`; the service spells it correctly.

wise-id.description: Branch code in the Wise library system.

region-profile.description: This holding is a regional cooperation profile.

ClosingInfo.description: Exceptional closing days. Covers the next 90 days unless `closeinfodays` says otherwise.

DayHours.description: One weekday. `@date` is the concrete date this weekday resolves to in the returned week, and `@today` flags the current day.

description.description: Legacy: the first remark field from Wise for the first time slot. Prefer `timespan/@description`.

timespan.description: Effective opening hours. Absent when the library is closed that day.

original-timespan.description: The normal hours for this weekday, returned alongside `timespan` when an exceptional closing overrides them.

special-closing-day.description: Marks the day as an exceptional closing day.

description.description: Remark field from Wise for this time slot.

AvailabilityItem.description: One or more physical copies. Copies sharing an extid and status are collapsed into a single element with `@count`.

extid.description: Bibliographic id of the edition held here.

avail-id.description: Id of the availability record this entry came from.

is-lead.description: This entry belongs to the record the request resolved to.

ibl.description: The copy can be requested through interlibrary loan.

count.description: Number of copies described by this element.

subloc.description: Sub-location, i.e. the department within the library.

shelfmark.description: Shelfmark as printed on the item's label.

status_.description: Status rendered in the requested language — the `<status>` child element, as distinct from the normalised `@status` attribute.

returndate.description: When an on-loan copy is due back.

receivaldate.description: When the copy was received into the collection.

placehold.description: Link to reserve the item, where applicable.

itemid.description: Unique copy id from the Wise library system.

wiseid.description: Wise title id. Every edition of a work has its own title id, and one title id may have several copy ids.

wise-branch-id.description: Branch code from the Wise library system.

custom.description: Profile-specific extras. Documented upstream but not returned by the `zbb` profile.

zizo.description: ZIZO classification (non-fiction) with an icon URL.

SearchAvailabilityResponse.description: Bulk availability for a page of search results. Reports `available` as soon as one present copy is found, so it carries no copy totals.

uses-first-child.description: The first child branch was substituted.

type.description: Perspective the endpoint answered from. The first `<status>` of each item is this perspective.

available.description: The headline answer for this external id.

status.description: First entry is the chosen perspective. A second entry appears only when every copy in that perspective is on loan; it then reports availability at profile or region level.

wise-status.description: Raw status from the Wise API.

original-query.description: The query behind the supplied `rctx`. Only present when `rctx` was given.

facets.description: Facets, wrapped in a `<facets>` element. Without `rctx` the facets are listed but carry no `<value>` terms — terms are counted against a search context.

IndexAllResponse.description: Every index and facet configured for the profile.

results.description: The profile's index configuration, split into facets and searchable indexes.

searchmethods.description: Indexes that can be used as a query prefix, e.g. `author:`.

IndexMeta.description: Paging metadata shared by the index endpoints.

enforcedmaximum.description: Server-side ceiling on entries per page.

retrievable.description: The index's terms can be browsed through `/index/{indexType}/`.

value.description: Index name, usable as a query prefix.

IndexTermsResponse.description:
One page of entries from a single index.

The entries are `<result>` elements **directly under the root** — there is no `<results>` wrapper, unlike `/search/` and `/index/all/`.

result.description: Index entries, one element per term.

results.description: The results wrapper. Unlike `/search/` it carries an attribute, so it is modelled as an element rather than a bare array.

type.description: Identifier type that was resolved, echoing the path segment.

itemid.description: Catalogue item ids carrying this identifier.

frabl.description: FRABL key of the matched work.

HoldingsResponse.description: Library branches with opening hours and addresses. Parent holdings appear at the same level as their children, distinguished by `holding/@parent`.

SearchJsonResponse.description:
Result list as returned by `output=json`.

**Undocumented format**, modelled from live responses rather than from the published documentation. It is not a transliteration of the XML: keys are renamed and flattened, and the `facets` block is omitted even when `refine=true` — only `meta` and `results` are ever present. Every scalar is a JSON **string**, including counts and booleans (`"83"`, `"true"`).

SearchJsonMeta.description: Result-set metadata. Note there is no `rctx` here, unlike the XML `meta`.

sort-methods.description: Sort options available for this result set.

RecordJson.description:
One record in the JSON rendering, used both inside `results` and as `/details/`'s `record`.

Which keys are present depends on `detaillevel`, on `librarian`, on the rich-vs-free tier, and on what the record itself carries — treat every property as optional. `marc21` appears from `detaillevel=extended` upwards. Scalars are strings throughout.

id.description: Full record id. Equivalent of the XML `id`.

titles.description: Titles, most significant first. Flattens the XML `titles` block.

authorsDetailed.description: The same authors with their components split out.

formats.description: Material types, with an icon path for each.

types.description: Publication types: Fictie, Non-Fictie, Muziek, Film.

isbn.description: ISBN numbers. EAN, ISSN and publisher numbers are not exposed separately here — use `marc21` or the XML `identifiers` block.

coverimages.description: Cover image URLs. Not available in the free API.

subject-local.description: Subject headings local to the library.

description.description: Collation, playing time and publication frequency, flattened into one list.

summaries.description: Summaries. Not available in the free API.

reviews.description: Reviews. Not available in the free API.

award.description: Award. Singular here, unlike the XML `awards` list.

enrichInfo.description: Ids this record was matched with. Equivalent of the XML `enrich-info`.

magazines.description: For an article, the magazine it appeared in.

cnt.description: Number of editions grouped under this key.

AuthorJson.description: Contributor with its components split out. Mirrors the attributes of the XML `author` element; identifier keys such as `wikidata` appear only where the authority record carries them.

full.description: Rendered name, matching the corresponding entry in `authors`.

birthyear.description: Birth year as catalogued; may carry a trailing dash.

localized-type.description: Author function in the requested language.

FormatJson.description: Material type with the icon the AquaBrowser front end uses for it.

text.description: Material type in the requested language.

icon.description: Icon path, relative to the AquaBrowser host.

UndupJson.description: Grouping across editions. Equivalent of the XML `undup-info`.

alsoAvailableAsCount.description: How many other editions of this work exist.

native.description: The same id without its prefix.

MagazineJson.description: Magazine an article was published in.

custom.description: Carries the issue reference as a `magazineinfo` entry.

CustomJson.description: Profile-specific extra. `type` says which shape the remaining keys take — `magazineinfo` carries the issue reference in `text`; `luisterpunt` carries request and audio-fragment URLs for the Luisterpunt library. Other types may appear for other profiles, so unknown keys should be tolerated.

text.description: Free text; for `magazineinfo` the issue reference.

title.description: URL-encoded title, as used when building the request link.

debug-src.description: Internal marker for the rule that produced this entry.

Marc21Json.description: The raw MARC21 record. Present from `detaillevel=extended` upwards.

fields.description: One entry per MARC field, each a single-key object whose key is the MARC tag. Control fields (`001`, `005`, `008`, …) map to a plain string; data fields map to an object with indicators and subfields.

ind1.description: First indicator; a space or an empty string when unset.

subfields.description: Subfields in record order, each a single-key object whose key is the subfield code.

DetailsJsonResponse.description:
Single record as returned by `output=json`.

**Undocumented format.** `meta` carries only `time-taken` — there is no `rctx`, and the XML-only `branches`, `ratings` and `reviews` blocks have no JSON counterpart, so callers that need those must request XML.

AvailabilityJsonResponse.description:
Availability as returned by `output=json`.

**Undocumented format**, and structurally different from the XML: instead of the nested `locations/location/holding` tree it returns one flat array of locations, each with its items. Opening hours, addresses and the source `records` block are XML-only.

availability.description: One entry per library location holding the title. Flat — no nesting of library and branch.

AvailabilityLocationJson.description: One location and the copies it holds.

available.description: `"true"` when at least one copy is on the shelf here. A string, not a boolean.

AvailabilityItemJson.description: One or more physical copies sharing an external id and status. Empty strings are used for absent values rather than omitting the key.

extid.description: Bibliographic id of the edition held.

count.description: Number of copies described by this entry.

shelfmark.description: Shelfmark printed on the item's label.

returndate.description: Due date of an on-loan copy, `DD-MM-YYYY`.

placeHoldUrl.description: Link to reserve the item. Equivalent of the XML `placehold`.

avi.description: AVI reading level, for children's material.

itemid.description: Unique copy id from the Wise library system.

wiseid.description: Wise title id of the edition.
